subject: Request: Move customer showcase to enable end-to-end ingest & prompt QA
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@finlytics.com>, FinLytics IT <it@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Move customer showcase to enable end-to-end ingest & prompt QA

Hi Samantha —

Quick note: a scheduling conflict came up on our side (I have unavoidable travel on 9/21) and we also flagged a couple of gaps during our last run of the sample ingest that mean the current showcase window won't let us demonstrate the full E2E flow the way we promised.

To make the session useful for your SRE and ML teams, we want to shift the live showcase by a few days so we can:
- finish prompt-set QA (edge cases + token budget checks)
- complete the sample schema ingest and verify trace-driven workloads
- run a dry-run with the runbook and shared credentials so the demo is stable

Would you be open to moving the session from 9/21 to one of these proposed windows?
- Tue 9/23, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/24, 13:00–14:00 PT

If neither works, happy to propose alternatives. I want to avoid a rushed demo that leaves questions on data handling and performance.

Attaching the current sample schema and a short QA checklist so your team can skim what we’ll validate.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: finlytics-sample-schema.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: redwood-qa-checklist.md (MD)]

From: Samantha Li <samantha@finlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv@finlytics.com>, FinLytics IT <it@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Move customer showcase to enable end-to-end ingest & prompt QA

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the checklist. We definitely prefer a complete walkthrough rather than a partial demo.

Quick notes from our side:
- Rajiv and I are available on 9/23 morning PT (which is late afternoon for us in ET) — that slot should work.
- Our infra team (cc’d) needs at least 48 hours to confirm temporary credentials for the ingest environment.
- Could you confirm whether the dry-run requires any network changes or only credentials and sample data?

If you can confirm the dry-run requirements, I’ll lock in 9/23 10:00 PT and notify our SREs.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Data Platform, FinLytics
samantha@finlytics.com

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Move customer showcase to enable end-to-end ingest & prompt QA

Hi Samantha — looping in Laura (solutions) and Monica (customer success) to finalize logistics.

Ben, thanks for flagging the gaps. Laura/Monica — can you confirm the following before we lock 9/23 at 10:00 PT?
1) Credentials: FinLytics IT needs a checklist of the minimal permissions we require. Monica, can you send that today?
2) Runbook: Laura, please attach the runbook (we should run one end-to-end dry-run with the same accounts we’ll use in the live showcase).
3) Prompt QA: Ben, can you share top-10 prompt variants and the token estimate so FinLytics can sign off?

Proposal: if we complete steps 1–3 by EOD 9/16 PT, we keep 9/23; if not, we propose the fallback of 9/27 AM PT.

Attachments in this thread are fine. I’ll prepare a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and post the link once created.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick status update from CS before we lock 9/23 10:00 PT:

- Credentials: FinLytics IT confirmed they’ll provision temporary S3/ingest credentials by 9/22 16:00 ET. We’ve sent the minimal permission list to them.
- Dry-run: Completed locally against a staging bucket; uncovered a small schema mismatch that we patched. Attached the runbook (v1) and a short note on the schema patch.
- Prompt pack: Ben attached the top-10 prompt variants to this reply and I ran them through our QA harness — performance looks stable for the expected token budget.

I’m locking in 9/23 10:00 PT for the live showcase. Monica will run the dry-run with FinLytics' creds at 9/22 12:00 PT and will send a short readiness note after.

See attached runbook and schema patch summary.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
